A farm that captures 119 seats therefore burns for 119 identities yet holds roughly one seat's influence, as its own consistency is what gives it away. Jurors whose votes correlate above 33% with each other have their weight reduced toward a single shared vote, and the correlation is computed over a window of epochs rather than per case.
